subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Now On!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale, with discounts of up to 50% on selected items! Don't miss this opportunity to upgrade your wardrobe with the latest summer trends at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online to discover amazing deals on clothing, accessories, and more. Hurry, as stocks are limited! Happy shopping! Best regards, The Fashion Store Team
